verdict.rationale: EFTPS is the U.S. Treasury/IRS's government-operated tax payment rail. Its core product is settlement of federal tax payments into Treasury accounts, which no user could run on their own infrastructure, so self-hosting is a category error for this kind of product. The downloadable Batch Provider Software is a client channel for submitting payments, not a self-hostable instance of the core system, so it does not make this axis applicable.
